demo8 classes
code:
# Classes
class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
    def norm2(self):
        return self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y
p = Point(3, 4)
print(p.norm2())
q = Point(1, 1)
print(q.norm2())

name: demo9 generators
code:
# Generators
def squares(n):
    for i in range(n):
        yield i * i
    return
print(list(squares(5)))
print(sum(squares(4)))
